title: Atomic-scale spin sensing of a 2D d-wave altermagnet via helical tunnelling
title_zh: 通过螺旋隧道进行原子尺度自旋感应的二维d波交替磁体
abstract: Altermagnets simultaneously possess momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting and zero net magnetization (1-6). Their defining crystalline symmetry connects opposite-spin sublattices in real space and imposes alternating spin polarization on the symmetry-related electronic states in momentum space (1-3). Identifying such an order and its associated spin response therefore calls for atomic-scale spin-sensitive measurements in both real and momentum space, an experimental milestone yet to be achieved. Here we show that the helical edge modes of the higher-order topological insulator α-Bi4Br4 can serve as a spin-selective scanning tunnelling microscopy probe of the two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic order in the surface layer of KV2Se2O. Atomically registered mapping reveals the spatial relationship between the two V sublattices and a density-wave lattice modulation, as well as real-space patterns consistent with the checkerboard antiferromagnetic order. Field-dependent spectroscopy further finds opposite energy shifts of the unidirectional quasiparticle excitations extending along two orthogonal crystal axes and a predominantly out-of-plane magnetic response. In momentum space, spin-sensitive quasiparticle interference imaging reveals a bias-reversing d-wave anisotropy between the symmetry-paired X and Y valleys. These results provide converging evidence for two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetism on the surface of KV2Se2O and demonstrate helical-edge-mode tunnelling as a route for atomic-scale spin sensing in quantum materials.
abstract_zh: 交替磁体同时具有动量相关的非相对论自旋分裂和零净磁化（1-6）。其特征晶体对称性在实空间中连接相反自旋子晶格，并在动量空间中的对称相关电子态上强加交替自旋极化（1-3）。因此，识别这种序及其相关的自旋反应需要在实空间和动量空间中进行原子尺度的自旋敏感测量，这是一项尚未实现的实验里程碑。本文表明，高阶拓扑绝缘体α-Bi4Br4的螺旋边缘模式可以作为一种自旋选择性扫描隧道显微镜探针，用于探测KV2Se2O表面层中二维d波交替磁序。原子登记成像揭示了两个V子晶格与密度波晶格调制之间的空间关系，以及与棋盘反铁磁序一致的实空间模式。场依赖光谱进一步发现，沿两个正交晶体轴延展的单向准粒子激发出现相反的能量位移，以及以面外为主的磁响应。在动量空间中，自旋敏感的准粒子干涉成像揭示了对称配对的X和Y谷之间随偏压反转的d波各向异性。这些结果为KV2Se2O表面二维d波交替磁性提供了汇聚证据，并证明螺旋边缘模式隧道是量子材料中原子尺度自旋感应的一种途径。
